value.value: Figure 3A: negative QDs 20/80/160 µg/mL, 24 h, 10×, representative of three independent experiments. Figure 3B images: AUT 3/5/10 nm and CYST 3 nm show 0.5/5/20; CYST 5/10 nm show 0.5/3.5 with no 20-dose image shown. Caption lists the union 0.5/3.5/5/20. Figure 3C negative histone ELISA 20/80/160, 24 h, mean ± SD, n=3 independent experiments, p < 0.01. Figure 3D positive ELISA 0.5/3.5/20, 24 h, mean ± SD, n=3, p < 0.025. The positive-QD bar panels list 0.5/3.5/20 µg/mL in their legends/captions, but 5 and 10 nm CYST groups show only two bars; a 20 µg/mL result is not inferred for those groups.

value.value: MPA induces no apoptotic response; MUA only at 10 nm/160 µg/mL in results prose. AUT response at 0.5 µg/mL is interpreted alongside overwhelming necrosis at higher doses; CYST 3 nm lacks apoptosis, 5/10 nm have modest responses in prose. Source Table 4 symbolic counts are retained independently and can differ from prose.

quality.review_scope: Independent review of all 15 main pages and consolidated correction delta accepted. SI and cited prior methods unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: No atomic-coordinate asset or crystallographic phase assignment reported in the scoped main text.
This is a biological characterization context, not an additional CdSe synthesis or structural pair.
No numerical bar/curve digitization; exact plotted evidence is retained as source crops.
The positive-QD bar panels list 0.5/3.5/20 µg/mL in their legends/captions, but 5 and 10 nm CYST groups show only two bars; a 20 µg/mL result is not inferred for those groups.
conflicts: Negative MUA/MPA: 20, 80, 160 µg/mL. Positive dose labels differ by assay/panel: general methods 0.5, 5, 20 µg/mL; Figures 2B, 3D, 4B, 5B use 0.5, 3.5, 20; Figure 3B images and Figures 5D/6 use their explicit labels. Never merge 3.5 and 5.
Ethidium bromide (AO/EB heading, figure captions) versus ethidium iodide (p.13 method sentence) unresolved.
Results prose describes MUA apoptosis only 10 nm/160 µg/mL, while Table 4 summarizes positive counts for all three MUA sizes. Do not collapse table and prose into one claim.
